stage: P07 protocol freeze for P08 M3e final evaluation
implementation_status: Specification only at P07; the final-test inference/evaluator and stress runner are not yet implemented. No P08 target access or scoring is authorized by this file alone.
design_disclosure: P05/P06 July outcomes are already known. This protocol is fixed before the P07 delivery simulation and before use of August-September final targets; it does not claim blind July design.
future_implementation_gate: P08 must register evaluator/stress/delivery source hashes, passing independent hand/boundary tests and exact metadata-only membership/opportunity inventories before opening final target payloads. Existing frozen core files must match these pins. New code must conform to this specification; no alteration of models, split, targets, rule, delivery parameters, stress cases, metrics or acceptance definitions based on final labels.

population.unit: (tenant_id, trip_id), original frozen split assignment test
population.required_scope: All original test trips and every frozen snapshot belonging to them; trip role remains fixed across local midnight. Snapshot clocks and selected label knowledge must be strictly before the cutoff. No target-based membership pruning.
population.group_definition: Heldout membership comes from the original frozen entity IDs, cross-checked against training metadata; never infer seen/unseen from final errors or label support. Include both sparse route-only and joint-heldout groups even when no metric can be estimated.
population.empty_group_rule: Emit the group with counts zero, metric null and a reason; do not omit it or count it as a perfect result.
population.expected_counts: Determined and pinned from metadata only before scoring; no target counts inspected at P07.

membership_gate: Build and hash the complete original test key inventory from assignments, departure evidence and snapshot metadata before any target access; each original test trip must retain all frozen opportunities. July42/341 counts do not apply.

pipeline.eta: P05 R01 selected gradient_boosting_quantile with its existing historical_baseline fallback; no refit, no transformer/vocabulary updates.
pipeline.probability: P05 R01 independent logistic_delay with its existing fold_prevalence fallback; no quantile-derived probability.
pipeline.training_history: Use the exact saved original-training history and transformers with knowledge before July 1. Do not incorporate July or earlier final-period arrivals into historical pools, even if they would later be known.
pipeline.calibration: Apply the existing per-tenant July1-10 trip-max nonnegative CQR80% map and constrained monotone probability sigmoid; exact states/support rules unchanged. No all-July refit.
pipeline.unsupported: Retain exact raw outputs as explicitly unsupported; no successful-calibration claim. P06 policy abstains unless probability calibration is fitted and ETA is available. Invalid values/model identity mismatches fail closed, not silent fallback.
pipeline.probability_clock_and_precision: Candidate rule uses six-decimal Decimal(str(p)), ROUND_HALF_EVEN, p>=0.550000. ETA formal projection: median HALF_EVEN whole seconds, lower FLOOR, upper CEILING, include projected median. Preserve precise forecasts for proper-score/calibration diagnostics; report canonical projection separately.
reference_comparisons: Saved historical-baseline ETA on its own and paired support
Raw versus calibrated frozen pipeline on identical eligible opportunities; no switching based on final results
Saved fold_prevalence probability baseline, if available from P05 refit state; no recomputed final prevalence baseline
pipeline.no_promotion: These references explain performance and quality regressions; they cannot choose a new deployed method after final testing.

targets.version_selection: For each final trip choose the latest original outcome version whose label availability is strictly before 2026-10-15T07:00:00Z, including withdrawal/cancellation/incomplete/pending revisions. Reject ambiguous same-known-time versions. Do not recover an older verified outcome when the latest eligible revision withdraws it.
targets.eta: Verified independent gate arrival with second or minute precision and exact positive remaining seconds arrival-snapshot. Exclude already arrived, missing, cancelled, incomplete, pending, withdrawn and insufficient precision with separate reasons. Do not use service start or delivery completion.
targets.binary_delay: Verified independent gate arrival with second precision, positive remaining time at the source snapshot, and arrival>snapshot-effective promise deadline; equality is on time, zero grace. ETA and probability eligibility may differ.
targets.promise_identity: Freeze each snapshot/candidate effective promise ID, deadline, known_at and provenance. At delivery or later reschedule, keep the candidate promise for its target and notice metric. Do not relabel a past candidate using the latest trip promise.
targets.unknowns: No mature eligible target means unknown/excluded, never on-time. Preserve reason/precision/cutoff/version and target availability denominators. Post-arrival records stay in opportunity/candidate/delivery accounting and are classified separately as non-useful.
targets.no_intervention_target: P07/P08 do not change arrival outcomes to simulate a successful action; causal or business-outcome follow-up belongs to P09 and cannot be inferred from delivery.

delivery_semantics.assumption_basis: Illustrative research transport assumptions fixed before this delivery simulation; not measured service rates or fitted from July/final outcomes.
delivery_semantics.causal_ties: Priority orders events already queued at the same timestamp. An event created by another event, such as a zero-lag receipt created by service, necessarily follows its cause before competing with other queued events.
delivery_semantics.clocks: Historical August-September events are synthetic counterfactual replay clocks. Actual final-evaluation execution/materialization timestamps are recorded separately. No real past notifications or recipient behavior are asserted.
delivery_semantics.cutoff: Known receipts at or before counts_as_of count; future confirmations remain queued/not_mature. Timeout is unresolved, not evidence of a negative response.
delivery_semantics.draw: SHA256 of compact UTF-8 JSON array [seed,version,tenant_id,candidate_id,attempt_index,dimension], first eight bytes unsigned big-endian modulo domain size; independent outcome/latency/receipt_lag dimensions.
delivery_semantics.gates: At dispatch and service: original snapshot deadline minus time >=1800, not closed, time <=creation+TTL, and time since previous successful service delivery for tenant/trip >=1800. Equality passes. Promise or episode changes never reset cooldown.
delivery_semantics.identity: candidate_id maps to one alert; delivery_id is an attempt; identical duplicated input is idempotent, conflicting duplicate rejected.
delivery_semantics.population: All frozen selected-rule risk episodes and candidates; missing feed censors risk, it does not establish closure.
delivery_semantics.retry: Only confirmed transient failure retries, after receipt and backoff. Unknown stops unresolved; never assume undelivered. Stop after service success. Maximum attempts and 600-second TTL bound all work.
delivery_semantics.unknown_states: No recipient opening, adoption, action or followup is generated in P07.

delivery_cutoff_boundary: Receipt known_at <= counts_as_of counts, matching P07 transport accounting. Final outcome label_known_at < label_cutoff remains exclusive. State both boundaries; a receipt at the boundary can count while a label first known at the boundary is excluded.

denominators.availability: All test opportunities/trips, plus native/fallback/unavailable and calibration fitted/unsupported counts, separately for ETA and probability.
denominators.forecast_scoring: For each target, metric cohort and reported slice, every scored trip has total weight one over that trips eligible available snapshots. Show eligible-before-availability and scored-after-availability counts. A missing forecast does not disappear from availability or all-eligible-trip coverage.
denominators.eta_whole_trip_coverage: All trips with at least one eligible ETA target. Success requires an interval at every eligible snapshot and every target inside its interval; any missing eligible forecast is a miss. Also report conditional full-availability coverage with its own denominator.
denominators.policy_support: All monitored trips count toward burden. Scored trips and actionable positive/negative support are label-defined, independent of forecast availability. Mixed-promise trips may contribute both positive and negative snapshot evidence; no invented immutable trip confusion matrix.
denominators.actionable_positive_trip: Any mature eligible positive snapshot with its frozen deadline-snapshot >=1800 seconds, even if forecast unavailable or candidate blocked. Denominator fixed from labels after inference, not from successful deliveries.
denominators.candidate_recall: Trips with any admitted candidate on an eligible positive target divided by actionable-positive trips; separately report the denominator of all observed-positive trips.
denominators.first_candidate: Chronologically first admitted candidate per tenant/trip, independent of future labels; exact time ties follow frozen deterministic identity ordering.
denominators.delivery_success: Only unique confirmed simulated service-delivery acknowledgments known by the delivery-observation cutoff. Failed, queued and unknown attempts are not successful deliveries; repeated ingestion of the same receipt identity is idempotent.
denominators.delivery_burden: Every unique successful delivery, including later reminders and duplicate successes, divided by all monitored trips and reported per100. Attempts, failed retries, first deliveries, episode repeats and per-trip additional deliveries are separate counts.
denominators.first_successful_delivery: Earliest successful service-delivery receipt per tenant/trip, sorted by delivered_at then frozen alert/delivery IDs, selected before consulting labels. Preserve its candidate snapshot/promise. Undelivered trips retain explicit missing first-delivery status and remain in recall/burden denominators. A first success with receipt unknown at cutoff is not yet counted as confirmed; preserve its latent simulator state only in the transport audit, never as observed successful delivery.
denominators.delivered_actionable_recall: A trip is captured only if some admitted candidate on an eligible positive target has a successful delivery with frozen deadline-delivered_at >=1800 seconds and delivery before actual arrival. Divide by the same label-defined actionable-positive trips. A candidate generated with enough notice but delivered too late is a miss.
denominators.first_delivery_precision: Useful first successful service deliveries / all known-assessable first successful deliveries, meaning classification is not unresolved. Mature eligible positive/negative targets, verified exact already-arrived targets, or independently known insufficient prospective delivered lead are assessable. Any known post-arrival or insufficient-lead timing makes a first delivery non-useful even when its delay label is unresolved. Only still-potentially-useful rows with unresolved outcome/arrival evidence remain unresolved. Never fabricate a binary negative target. This usefulness measure differs from P06 positive-first-candidate precision.
denominators.first_effective_delivery: Secondary event: earliest successful delivery meeting eligible-positive and >=1800s delivered lead. Report its lead distribution only among captured trips, beside the full recall denominator. Do not use this favorable subset to replace first-successful-delivery precision.

clocks.candidate_prospective_lead_seconds: candidate frozen deadline - simulated candidate issue_at
clocks.delivered_prospective_lead_seconds: same frozen deadline - first successful service delivered_at
clocks.actual_arrival_advance_seconds: actual gate arrival - successful delivered_at, only when mature valid arrival exists; separate from promise lead
clocks.transport_latency_seconds: successful delivered_at - simulated candidate issue_at; nonnegative; failed attempts retain separate scheduled/sent/failure clocks
clocks.actual_execution_clock: Real offline generated/released/verification timestamps are separate from simulated historical candidate/attempt/delivery clocks. Neither implies July/August/September real deployment.
clocks.daily_cap_scope: Existing cap2 constrains admitted candidates per tenant/local day, not successful deliveries or network retry attempts. Later-day retries and duplicate successes can exceed that number; do not silently claim a delivery cap without a separately frozen delivery rule.

eta_secondary: raw quantile pinball at0.1/0.5/0.9 before calibration only
canonical outward-projection coverage/width deltas beside precise interval results
metrics.eta_warning: Calibrated expanded endpoints are interval bounds, not recalibrated quantiles; do not label their scores as P10/P90 quantile accuracy.
probability: log loss with fixed epsilon1e-15 and clipping count
metrics.probability_conventions: Use original precise probabilities for proper scores/reliability and preserve the six-decimal policy number separately. Fixed bins [0,.1),...,[.9,1]; full-cohort trip weights retained in bins, not re-normalized per bin. AUC/AP are null with explicit reason when either class is absent. For declared fixed bins use left-closed/right-open intervals except final bin includes1; no rebinning after final outcomes.
candidate_and_delivery: all declared P06 candidate metrics for comparability
all-observed-positive delivered-trip recall with its stated target rule
conditional useful-first-successful-delivery precision and known-assessable target coverage
successful-delivery repeat count per episode and additional successes per trip
delivery lead/latency distributions and rates below1800, at/afterdeadline, and at/afteractualarrival
business_exclusions: No acceptance/rejection/open-rate estimate without explicit synthetic event evidence
No saved labor, reduced delay, ROI or causal intervention benefit
metrics.distribution_summary: For lead and latency, report N plus min,p10,p25,median,p75,p90,max using fixed linear interpolation r=(n-1)*p; null when N=0. State which candidate/first-delivery/first-effective cohort each distribution describes.

delivery_slices: first-attempt success versus retry-success versus never-confirmed
subgroups.sparse: Flag any scored subgroup with fewer than20 trips. Publish counts and null reasons even when too sparse for interval estimation. Do not add data-driven intersections or choose methods based on subgroup winners.

uncertainty.scope: Descriptive uncertainty within the fixed synthetic final cohort, not future-fleet confidence or exchangeability assurance.

forecast_bootstrap.unit: whole tenant/trip contribution, preserving every snapshot and paired method/variant record together
forecast_bootstrap.stratification: tenant x frozen route/vehicle novelty group; preserve each nonempty stratum trip count
forecast_bootstrap.generator: Python random.Random with a protocol-pinned seed; sorted stratum and trip key ordering
forecast_bootstrap.quantile_interpolation: linear r=(n-1)*p over sorted non-null replicate values
forecast_bootstrap.paired_deltas: Use identical resampled trip keys for raw/calibrated and candidate/baseline differences; keep paired support fixed
forecast_bootstrap.undefined_replicates: Do not silently discard. If any required denominator is zero or fewer than20 original scored trips exist, emit null interval with reason and replicate diagnostics. No bootstrap of AUC/AP on small/single-class groups.

uncertainty.policy_delivery: Use exact count fractions, target coverage, tenant/month diagnostics and unresolved-first-delivery identification bounds. Do not present iid binomial confidence intervals or rerun capacity admission on a bootstrap pseudo-population; shared daily caps couple trip outcomes. Any later cluster/block interval requires a separate pre-outcome specification.
uncertainty.identification_bounds: For all first successful deliveries N, confirmed useful T and unresolved-but-potentially-useful U: lower=T/N, upper=(T+U)/N; null forN=0. Known false, insufficient-lead and verified exact post-arrival deliveries are non-useful and not in U even if the binary delay target is unavailable. These are usefulness identification bounds, not confidence intervals.

stress.scope: Outcome-independent input robustness checks and transport scenarios, specified before P07 delivery results and P08 targets. They are not new factual source observations, calibrated forecasts of a counterfactual fleet or causal effects.
stress.inventory: Every stress scenario retains every baseline test opportunity/trip key. No target-based selection, row removal or new split. Record affected/not_applicable row counts and exact before/after feature values. Apply frozen preprocessing after each feature perturbation; never refit it.

scenarios.transform: No feature/transport change. Use frozen P07 delivery law with P08 counts_as_of.

scenarios.apply_to: Opportunities with elapsed_trip_seconds>=1800 and original position_validity not no_position; others unchanged with not_applicable reason
scenarios.invariant: Age1800>frozen stale threshold900 and <=elapsed. This is a derived feature-input perturbation, not an alteration of retained raw telemetry/source clocks.

Assert token absent from each saved vocabulary before evaluation; use the existing unknown slot. Keep canonical/source route ID and original novelty cohort unchanged and retain explicit feature-override audit.

scenarios.role: mandatory unmodified subgroup report, not an additional transformed population
scenarios.transform: No input changes. Report all four original seen/unseen route x vehicle groups from S00. Vehicle IDs are excluded predictors; do not invent a vehicle-feature perturbation or claim new vehicle training.

scenarios.role: model-input long-stop sensitivity, not confirmed physical dwell
scenarios.apply_to: Per trip, the earliest three consecutive opportunities with elapsed>=3600, original valid position, nonnull remaining distance, and first-to-third snapshot span>=3600 seconds; if absent, unchanged/not_applicable. Choose using metadata/features only.
scenarios.transform: For these three opportunities set speed=0, position_age_seconds=0, position_validity=valid, and remaining_distance_km to the first selected opportunity value. Leave snapshot clock, elapsed, route distance, deadline and target unchanged.
invariants: Fixed three-opportunity window; no extension selected by results
Retained distance must remain within route distance; otherwise fail the stress contract
No invented change to actual arrival or claim of causal traffic delay

scenarios.transform: Multiply route_distance_km and each nonnull remaining_distance_km by exact Decimal1.25; retain nulls and categorical route identity. Convert to finite numeric inputs without refitting saved scales.
invariants: Nonnegative remaining distance bounded by scaled route distance
No source-warehouse rewrite or new outcome generation

scenarios.unchanged: Same P07 seed/version/dimension keys, probability ordering, max3 attempts,30/120 backoffs,120 timeout,600 TTL,1800 notice and successful-delivery cooldown. Same underlying hash integers; do not redraw until success.

scenarios.invariant: One fixed combination, not a search over combinations.

stress.selection: No stress case ranks or replaces S00. Publish all cases with support and failures; do not pick the least harmful transformation or alter the final policy.

engineering_required: No final target fields passed to inference, policy or delivery simulator
All opportunities retained and temporal/version/tenant isolation enforced
Replay and independent references agree within predeclared numeric tolerance; identities/states/counts exact
Delivery bounded retries, idempotent receipts, timing and failure accounting pass deterministic fixtures
Original M2/P05/P06 evidence unchanged and fresh atomic output published only after validation
quality_descriptors: eta_whole_trip_point_target_met = observed all-eligible-trip coverage>=0.8; null if no eligible trips; this is not a future coverage guarantee
raw-vs-calibrated Brier/logloss/interval-score deltas explicitly report deterioration
candidate budget50/100 and daily cap2 compliance reported without reselection; delivery burden reported under its distinct clock/denominator
actionable-delivery recall and first-successful precision reported with support, unknowns, sparse flags and P05/P06 open limitations
decision_gates.no_invented_acceptance: No operational minimum precision/recall, allowable interval width, transport SLA, measured capacity or monetary cost has been established. Do not invent pass thresholds and retrospectively call them customer acceptance. P05 G14/G15 and P06 low-recall G16 stay open unless separately assessed under explicit criteria.
decision_gates.final_conclusion: A final-evaluation run may be engineering_complete with poor quality, sparse cohorts or budget failures. quality_accepted and operational_approval remain false; no automatic promotion from successful execution.

failure_behavior: Hash/protocol/identity/time/schema mismatch: stop before scoring and retain a separate failure receipt; do not publish partial success.

Unsupported model/calibrator/forecast: preserve explicit unavailable or raw-unsupported values per existing rules, keep denominator rows, and abstain from candidates when frozen rule requires support.
No eligible targets, one class, zero deliveries or sparse group: null metric with exact reason and counts; never zeros implying good quality.
Delivery timeout/failure/unknown: finite frozen retries only; no unlimited retry until success. Unknown at cutoff remains censored, not nondelivery rejection or nonadoption.
Observed model/calibration/policy quality failure: finish and retain the entire prespecified result without retuning or hiding failing slices.
Code bug discovered after final access: preserve prior artifacts, fix in a new documented version, rerun only for correction; explicitly state test exposure and do not reclaim an untouched holdout.
execution_order: Validate the frozen protocol and all source/code/artifact hashes; capture actual start time and environment.

Build exact final metadata/opportunity inventory; generate and retain all raw/calibrated forecasts and all policy/delivery ledgers without outcome inputs. Freeze these artifacts and their hashes before target joins.
Only then open authorized final target groups, select cutoff-known outcome versions, calculate all predeclared metrics/slices, and record exclusions without deleting opportunities.
Run independent source/metric and typed-store checks; publish complete result and all failure flags together.
reruns: Reruns may verify deterministic behavior only. A defect correction needs a versioned correction record and preserved first result; after outcome exposure, a corrected result is not a new untouched test. No scientific retuning or reassignment under the same final-test claim.

exact: all counts and integer projected values
comparison_tolerance.rule: Numerically close raw forecasts do not excuse a different canonical threshold decision; fail rather than loosen tolerances after final results.

expected_artifacts: pre-outcome protocol/config freeze and source/code/model/calibrator/rule/delivery/stress pin manifest
raw and calibrated forecasts plus canonical projection audit
candidate/attempt/receipt/first-delivery ledgers with simulated clocks separate from actual execution
ETA/probability/candidate/delivery metrics and denominators, mandatory slices, reliability and descriptive intervals/bounds
all stress outputs under fixed scenario IDs
independent references, hand fixtures, mutation guards and retained/source replay receipts
first final result and any later corrections retained separately; no overwrite

specification.meaning: Records prospective transport/evaluation assumptions; does not claim final evaluator or complete delivery implementation already validated.

evaluation_readiness.timing: After P07 engineering validation and before any P08 final-target access
evaluation_readiness.meaning: Demonstrates implementation readiness and immutable score-affecting delivery behavior before final evaluation, without claiming July delivery was still unseen.

freeze_records.future_evaluator_gate: P08 still must pin its new inference/evaluator/stress implementation and passing preregistered conformance tests before opening final target payloads.
